news.title: PS4 11.00 PPPwn Jailbreak Available
news.body: PPPwn exploit by TheOfficialFloW supports PS4 on firmware 11.00 and below. Run GoldHEN after exploit for homebrew. Stay on 11.00 or lower, do NOT update if you want homebrew.

news.title: PS5 UMTX Jailbreak up to 7.61
news.body: UMTX kernel exploit chain supports PS5 firmwares up to 7.61 with ItemzFlow / etaHEN. Higher firmwares are patched. Do not update past 7.61.

news.title: New PS5 Exploit In Progress
news.body: Developers reported progress on a new userland entry point. No release yet. Stay on lowest firmware possible and disable auto-updates.

firmwares.notes: Security fixes. Patches PPPwn. No jailbreak. Stay below 11.00 for homebrew.
Last vulnerable to PPPwn. Use PPPwn + GoldHEN.
Last version supporting UMTX. Use etaHEN. Disable updates.
